description: Multi-camera AI inference GUI for Axelera Metis AIPU on Aetina AN110

cameras.note: Odd-numbered nodes (21, 23) are metadata-only — never use as capture source

known_issues.usb_bandwidth: Two Brio 100 cameras on usb 7 share bandwidth; one must run at <=640x480
known_issues.configure_device_block: configure_device() for core-0 blocks while any inference runs; solved via AXELERA_CONFIGURE_BOARD=0 + boot flag
known_issues.sdk_not_reentrant: create_inference_stream() crashes if called from two threads in same process; use one process per profile
known_issues.crlf_corruption: Windows-edited .sh files export PYTHONPATH with \r; always dos2unix after Windows sync
known_issues.wrong_camera_node: usb:21 opens /dev/video21 (metadata only) — no frames, pipeline stays READY forever

patches_in_server._patched_configure_boards: Core offset partitioning + 12s timeout on configure_device
patches_in_server._patched_build_gst_usb: Forces v4l2src io-mode=2 (mmap) to avoid DMA-BUF contention with multi-camera
patches_in_server.stream_create_lock: _stream_create_lock serialises create_inference_stream() calls within one process
patches_in_server.sdk_path_strip: _sdk_root uses .strip() to remove CRLF from env var

preferences.default_editor: Edit tool (not Write) for existing files
